mapper.insert: INSERT INTO posts (user_id, content, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{content}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: INSERT INTO posts (user_id, content, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{content}, NOW(), NOW()) RETURNING id, content, (SELECT id FROM users WHERE id = #{userId}) AS authorId, (SELECT username FROM users WHERE id = #{userId}) AS authorUsername, (SELECT display_name FROM users WHERE id = #{userId}) AS authorDisplayName, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, 0 AS likeCount, 0 AS commentCount, false AS liked

UPDATE posts SET content = #{content}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} RETURNING id, content, (SELECT id FROM users u WHERE u.id = user_id) AS authorId, (SELECT username FROM users u WHERE u.id = user_id) AS authorUsername, (SELECT display_name FROM users u WHERE u.id = user_id) AS authorDisplayName, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM likes l WHERE l.post_id = id) AS likeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c WHERE c.post_id = id) AS commentCount, (SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM likes lx JOIN users cu ON cu.id = lx.user_id WHERE lx.post_id = id AND cu.email = #{currentUserEmail} )) AS liked

SELECT p.id AS id, p.content AS content, u.id AS authorId, u.username AS authorUsername, u.display_name AS authorDisplayName, p.created_at AS createdAt, p.updated_at AS updatedAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM likes l WHERE l.post_id = p.id) AS likeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c WHERE c.post_id = p.id) AS commentCount, (SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM likes lx JOIN users cu ON cu.id = lx.user_id WHERE lx.post_id = p.id AND cu.email = #{currentUserEmail} )) AS liked FROM posts p INNER JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.id ORDER BY p.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT p.id AS id, p.content AS content, u.id AS authorId, u.username AS authorUsername, u.display_name AS authorDisplayName, p.created_at AS createdAt, p.updated_at AS updatedAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM likes l WHERE l.post_id = p.id) AS likeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c WHERE c.post_id = p.id) AS commentCount, (SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM likes lx JOIN users cu ON cu.id = lx.user_id WHERE lx.post_id = p.id AND cu.email = #{currentUserEmail} )) AS liked FROM posts p INNER JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE p.id = #{id}

SELECT p.id AS id, p.content AS content, u.id AS authorId, u.username AS authorUsername, u.display_name AS authorDisplayName, p.created_at AS createdAt, p.updated_at AS updatedAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM likes l WHERE l.post_id = p.id) AS likeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c WHERE c.post_id = p.id) AS commentCount, (SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM likes lx JOIN users cu ON cu.id = lx.user_id WHERE lx.post_id = p.id AND cu.email = #{currentUserEmail} )) AS liked FROM posts p INNER JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY p.created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE posts SET content = #{content}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
